decision.question: Does comparison with the source image show that a frog has been added inside the toilet bowl in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass if comparison of the source and edited images clearly establishes that at least one frog has been added within the toilet bowl. A frog only on the raised lid, tank, or nearby floor does not satisfy this condition. Fail if the images clearly establish that no frog has been added inside the bowl. Unknown if the relevant source-to-edit change or placement cannot be determined. Additional frogs elsewhere do not invalidate a frog added inside the bowl; the instruction does not require exactly one frog.
decision.binding: Compare the toilet bowl in the source image with the same toilet bowl in the edited image. Evaluate only R1, 'Put a frog in the toilet,' with the requested target of a frog visibly placed within that bowl and the reference of the toilet in the input image.
